title: Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.13991v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-evolving agents improve through repeated cycles of modification and evaluation. However, existing methods receive feedback on modifications only after costly evaluations, and aggregate scores may obscure distinctions between failures that require different repairs. We introduce predictive self-evolution through an editable Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM). Before evaluation, the IDM predicts task-level outcomes of a proposed modification and guides an optional revision. After evaluation, past modifications and their observed outcomes are used to improve the IDM, allowing predictive knowledge to accumulate across generations. The system can thus improve how it solves tasks, proposes modifications, and predicts their effects. Building on HyperAgents, we evaluate this approach across multilingual coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and Olympiad-level mathematical grading. Our approach outperforms HyperAgents across all four

translated_title: 先预测再修改：为自进化智能体学习改进动力学
translated_abstract: 自进化智能体通过反复的修改与评估循环来提升自身。然而，现有方法只有在代价高昂的评估之后才能获得关于修改的反馈，且汇总性的分数可能掩盖需要不同修复方式的各类失败之间的区别。我们通过一个可编辑的改进动力学模型（IDM）引入了预测式自进化。在评估之前，IDM会预测所提出修改在任务层面的结果，并指导一次可选的修订。在评估之后，过去的修改及其观测到的结果被用于改进IDM，使预测知识能够跨代际不断积累。由此，系统可以同时改进其解决任务、提出修改以及预测修改效果的能力。基于HyperAgents，我们在多语言编程、论文评审、机器人奖励设计和奥赛级数学评分四个任务上评估了该方法。我们的方法在全部四个任务上均优于HyperAgents。
tldr: 提出可编辑的改进动力学模型（IDM），在评估前预测修改的任务级结果、评估后利用反馈持续积累预测知识，实现“先预测再修改”的预测式自进化框架，并在四个任务上全面超越HyperAgents。
en_tdlr: Proposes an editable Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM) that predicts task-level outcomes of proposed modifications before evaluation and accumulates predictive knowledge across generations, enabling predictive self-evolution that outperforms HyperAgents on four diverse tasks.
